Spark is a decentralized lending protocol that operates through smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Spark is non-custodial, so users keep control of their assets without a central intermediary. Spark is associated with the MakerDAO (Sky) ecosystem.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange that operates through smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Uniswap uses an automated market maker design based on liquidity pools rather than an order book. Uniswap is non-custodial, so traders swap tokens directly from their own wallets. Uniswap is governed by holders of its UNI governance token.

Across is a cross-chain bridge protocol that transfers assets between public blockchains through smart contracts. Across uses relayers to fill user transfer requests on the destination chain. Across relies on an optimistic oracle mechanism to resolve disputes about relayed transfers.

Yearn Finance is a yield aggregator that operates through smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Yearn Finance offers vaults that automatically allocate deposited funds to yield strategies. Yearn Finance is governed by holders of its YFI governance token.

Harvest is a yield aggregator, known as Harvest Finance, that operates through smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Harvest automatically reinvests yield from farming strategies for its depositors. Harvest issues the FARM governance token. Harvest suffered a flash loan exploit in October 2020.
